messages:
zara: Heads-up — saw a spike on primary model 'redwood-3b' in us-east; latency climbed and requests were being dropped. proposing an autoswap to a compatible variant (redwood-3b-quant or redwood-3b-mlm) when saturation >85% for 30s.
jonathan: +1 on auto-swap but must respect customer tier. do NOT silently downgrade paid performance for committed tenants.
lee: agree. policy suggestion: fallback only to variants with compatible API semantics and within the same quality bracket; allow per-tenant opt-out and a tenant QoS pin.
samir: region affinity: if us-east primary is saturated but us-west has capacity, prefer local variant in the same region before cross-region fallback. cross-region should be last resort.
maya: console UX: show a per-route 'spillover' badge + timeline and top impacted tenants. tenant settings should expose a 'fallback-policy' toggle and an explanation.
ops-bot: deploy started: feature/auto-fallback-proto -> staging
zara: quick proto for router header:
```
X-Redwood-Fallback: enable=true; prefer_local=true; max_quality_drop=0.05
```
server-side flag example: fallback_mode = [off, compatible-only, best-effort]
jonathan: telemetry needed: fallback.count, fallback.latency_penalty_ms, fallback.failed_quick_retries, per_tenant.fallback_rate. console histograms and alert when fallback_rate > 1% for paid tenants.
lee: also capture fallback_quality_delta per eval prompt-set id and surface to Optimize so product teams can triage regressions.
samir: billing question: if we fallback to a cheaper quantized variant but deliver same SLA, which rate applies? need product+billing/legal decision. tagging @product @billing here.
maya: UX: flag transcripts as 'downgraded' with link to diff report and an appeal button for customers. show exact variant used.
zara: ops constraint: cap auto-fallback hops to 1 (no cascading auto-fallbacks) unless operator overrides. prevent oscillation.
jonathan: impl note: router should accept tenant-scoped priority token (preserve priority across hops) and carry trace_id. preserve QoS header.
lee: rollout plan: region-gated feature flag; canary 5% traffic per region for 2 weeks. require telemetry field fallback_decision_reason and fallback_path.
samir: I'll draft RFC PLAT-XXXX and create follow-ups for billing/product. will @product and @billing in the RFC.
zara: thanks — creating RFC and will attach telemetry dashboard mockups. :thumbsup:
